60  def __callback_advertise_shutdown(self, req):
61  if req.value == AdvertiseShutdownRequest.SHUTDOWN:
62  self.__shutdown_advertise(RobotStatus.SHUTDOWN)
63  return CommandStatus.SUCCESS, "Success"
64  elif req.value == AdvertiseShutdownRequest.REBOOT:
65  self.__shutdown_advertise(RobotStatus.REBOOT)
66  return CommandStatus.SUCCESS, "Success"
67  elif req.value == AdvertiseShutdownRequest.UPDATE:
68  self.__shutdown_advertise(RobotStatus.UPDATE)
69  return CommandStatus.SUCCESS, "Success"
70 
71  return CommandStatus.FAILURE, "Bad arguments"

183  def __check_hardware_error(self):
184  new_robot_status = RobotStatus.UNKNOWN

187  if HardwareStatus.REBOOT == self.__robot_status_observer.hardware_status.hardware_state:

189  elif self.__robot_status_observer.hardware_status.error_message or \
190  HardwareStatus.ERROR == self.__robot_status_observer.hardware_status.hardware_state:
191  new_robot_status = RobotStatus.MOTOR_ERROR
192  new_robot_message = self.__robot_status_observer.hardware_status.error_message
193  else:
194  motors = zip(self.__robot_status_observer.hardware_status.motor_names,
195  self.__robot_status_observer.hardware_status.hardware_errors_message)
196  for motor_name, motor_error in motors:
197  if not motor_name.startswith('joint_'):
198  continue
199  if motor_error == '' or motor_error == 'Overload':
200  continue
201  new_robot_status = RobotStatus.MOTOR_ERROR
202  new_robot_message += "{}: {}\n".format(motor_name, motor_error)
203 
204  return new_robot_status, new_robot_message

206  def __check_regular_robot_status(self):
207  self.__autonomous_mode = self.get_autonomous_status()
208  if self.__robot_status_observer.hardware_status.calibration_in_progress:
209  robot_status = RobotStatus.CALIBRATION_IN_PROGRESS
210  elif self.__robot_status_observer.hardware_status.calibration_needed:
211  robot_status = RobotStatus.CALIBRATION_NEEDED
212  elif self.__robot_status_observer.learning_trajectory:
213  robot_status = RobotStatus.LEARNING_TRAJECTORY
214  elif self.__robot_status_observer.learning_mode_state and not self.__autonomous_mode:
215  robot_status = RobotStatus.LEARNING_MODE
216  elif self.__robot_status_observer.pause_state == PausePlanExecution.PAUSE:
217  robot_status = RobotStatus.PAUSE
218  elif self.__robot_status_observer.is_debug_motor_active:
219  robot_status = RobotStatus.RUNNING_DEBUG
220  elif self.__autonomous_mode:
221  if self.__robot_status_observer.learning_mode_state:
222  robot_status = RobotStatus.LEARNING_MODE_AUTONOMOUS
223  else:
224  robot_status = RobotStatus.RUNNING_AUTONOMOUS
225  elif self.__robot_status_observer.motion_goal_is_active or self.__robot_status_observer.jog_is_enabled:
226  robot_status = RobotStatus.MOVING
227  # waiting for user intervention to clear these errors
228  elif self.__robot_status not in [RobotStatus.COLLISION, RobotStatus.USER_PROGRAM_ERROR]:
229  robot_status = RobotStatus.STANDBY
230  else:
231  raise NoChangesException
232 
233  return robot_status, ROBOT_STATUS_TO_MESSAGE[robot_status]

235  def __check_motion_errors(self):
236  # - Program or motion errors
237  if self.__robot_status_observer.collision_detected:
238  robot_status, robot_message = RobotStatus.COLLISION, ROBOT_STATUS_TO_MESSAGE[RobotStatus.COLLISION]
239  self.__robot_status_observer.collision_detected = False
240  elif self.__robot_status == RobotStatus.COLLISION and self.__robot_status_observer.program_error:
241  # Stay at collision status
242  raise NoChangesException
243  elif self.__robot_status_observer.program_error:
244  robot_status = RobotStatus.USER_PROGRAM_ERROR
245  robot_message = self.__robot_status_observer.program_error_message
246  else:
247  robot_status, robot_message = RobotStatus.UNKNOWN, ""
248 
249  return robot_status, robot_message

251  def __check_ros_state(self):

261
